confluence-normal-form.summary: Prime-free (product,active-count) monovariant for (a); Newman's Lemma (terminating+locally confluent) for (b) as normal-form uniqueness, no closed form. Load-bearing gap: local-confluence overlap case.

per-prime-gcd-invariant.last_note: Complete rigorous proof of both parts; closed form M=∏p^{g_p} brute-force verified; APPROVE, solved.
per-prime-gcd-invariant.summary: p-adic decoupling; g_p=gcd of each prime's exponent multiset is exact invariant; (Ω,K) lex monovariant + lcm>1 non-collapse give (a); M=∏p^{g_p} gives (b).

strong-induction-descent.last_note: Complete rigorous proof of both parts via strong induction carrying μ(B) in IH; APPROVE, solved.
strong-induction-descent.summary: Strong induction on (Ω,K); IH carries value μ(B)=∏p^{g_p}; every first move preserves μ and drops potential, so (b) order-independence falls out of the IH.
